Chosen Weapon grants its level-based bonus to attacks and damage with the selected weapon group only. It is included on the equipped Falchion actions, not on unrelated weapons.

contextNotes.text: Apply the listed chosen weapon bonus to attacks with the source weapon group if it is not already included in the statblock.

description.value: An orc remains conscious and can continue fighting even if its hit points total is below 0. It is still staggered and loses 1 hit point each round. A creature with ferocity still dies when its hit points total reaches a negative amount equal to its Constitution score.
Orcs gain a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatic checks made with this skill. Alternatively, Orcs also gain a +1 racial bonus on Climb and Jump Skills.

contextNotes.text: Use Jump Check only for jumping; do not add the base Acrobatics bonus a second time.

description.value: Orcs will throw anything that it engages as a way for it to make sure it is the victor. Orcs gain the Throw Anything feat.

contextNotes.text: Ignore the improvised ranged weapon penalty; +1 circumstance on attacks with thrown splash weapons, not all thrown weapons.

description.value: Orcs are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon.

contextNotes.text: Proficient with greataxe and falchion; orc weapons count as martial.

description.value: Below 0 HP, conscious but staggered; lose 1 HP each round.

contextNotes.text: Dies at negative Constitution as usual.

description.value: Additional bonus on the jump subset of Acrobatics checks.
